units.source_text: 随着我那美好的回忆的增强，

en.t: As those beautiful memories of mine grew stronger,

units.source_text: 这黑暗就变成了基础，可以任意在上面描绘幻影了。

en.t: this darkness became a foundation on which phantoms could be freely drawn.

units.source_text: 在这蹲着的黑暗的形态中，

en.t: Within the shape of this crouching darkness,

units.source_text: 隐藏着被我认为是美的东西的全貌。

en.t: there lay hidden the full form of what I regarded as beauty.

units.source_text: 以回忆的力量，使美的细部逐一地从黑暗中闪烁出来，

en.t: By the power of memory, the details of beauty made themselves shine one by one out of the darkness,

units.source_text: 这闪烁传播开去，

en.t: and this glitter spread outward,

units.source_text: 金阁终于在既不是白昼也不是黑夜的不可思议的时光之下，

en.t: until at last, beneath a mysterious time that was neither day nor night, the Golden Pavilion

units.source_text: 渐渐地变成了清晰可见的东西。

en.t: gradually became something clearly visible.

units.source_text: 金阁从未曾以如此完整而精致的姿态，

en.t: Never before had the Golden Pavilion, in such a complete and exquisite form,

units.source_text: 各个角落都闪烁着突现在我的眼前。

en.t: appeared suddenly before my eyes with every corner glittering.

units.source_text: 我仿佛将盲人的视力当做自己的视力了。

en.t: It was as though I had taken a blind man's sight for my own.

units.source_text: 金阁因自身的发光而变得透明，

en.t: The Golden Pavilion became transparent through its own radiance,

units.source_text: 从外面也可以清清楚楚地看到期音洞壁顶的仙女奏乐图案，

en.t: so that even from outside one could clearly see the pattern of celestial maidens playing music on the upper wall of Choondo,

units.source_text: 以及究竟顶墙上斑驳的古老金箔的残片。

en.t: as well as the mottled remnants of old gold leaf on the walls of Kukkyoucho.

units.source_text: 金阁精巧的外部，与它的内部浑然一体了。

en.t: The delicate exterior of the Golden Pavilion had become one with its interior.

units.source_text: 我的眼睛可以把它的结构和主题明了的轮廓、

en.t: My eyes could take in its structure and the clear outline of its theme,

units.source_text: 主题具体化的细部的精心的重复和装饰、

en.t: the careful repetitions and ornaments of the details that embodied that theme,

units.source_text: 对比和对称的效果等等一览无遗。

en.t: and the effects of contrast and symmetry, all without omission.

units.source_text: 法水寺和潮音洞的同样宽广的二层，

en.t: The two equally broad stories, Hosuiin and Choondo,

units.source_text: 呈现了微妙的差异，尽管如此，

en.t: showed subtle differences, and yet,

units.source_text: 它们却是在同一深屋檐的庇护之下，

en.t: they were sheltered beneath the same deep eaves,

units.source_text: 就像一双颇为相似的梦、

en.t: like a pair of very similar dreams,

units.source_text: 一对颇为相似的快乐的纪念重叠起来了。

en.t: like two very similar happy memories laid one over the other.

units.source_text: 本来倘使只是其中之一就会容易让人忘却的东西，

en.t: What would originally have been easy to forget if there had been only one of them

units.source_text: 现在轻易地从上下将其弄明白了，

en.t: was now made plain from above and below with ease,

units.source_text: 因此梦变成了现实，快乐变成了建筑。

en.t: and so dream became reality, and happiness became architecture.

units.source_text: 但第三层究竟顶忽然缩小的形状。

en.t: But the suddenly narrowing shape of the third story, Kukkyoucho,

units.source_text: 使得一度弄明白的现实崩溃了，

en.t: caused the reality that had once been made clear to collapse,

units.source_text: 被那个黑暗而辉煌的时代的高超哲学所概括，

en.t: to be summed up by the lofty philosophy of that dark and brilliant age,

units.source_text: 乃至于屈服这种概括。

en.t: and finally to submit to that summation.

units.source_text: 于是薄木修耷的屋顶高耸，

en.t: Then the roof of thin shingles rose high,

units.source_text: 金铜凤凰连接着无明的长夜。

en.t: and the gilt bronze phoenix joined itself to the long night of ignorance.
